title: Early music: little blues, marches and mother's opera
summary: As a boy he heard marches and songs from the brass band but little blues; his mother sang mostly opera and French songs.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Uh, I might ask a little bit once more about the very early days when you were a child. Uh, did you ever hear any blues up in the country there? Did they have like guitar players or banjo players just playing blues, the singing and all much with the, uh, or was it mostly the, uh, the brass band that you remember? I'm wondering what other kind of music you might have heard up there.
